passage.title: A Rooftop That Watches the Weather
passage.deck: How a library made local measurements visible.

sections.heading: An instrument in public
paragraphs: The East Vale Library placed a small weather station on its roof. Readings appeared on a screen by the entrance, where visitors could compare the current temperature with the previous week.
Volunteers checked the equipment each Friday. The project did not replace the national forecast; it gave school groups a local set of observations to discuss.

questions.prompt: Where could visitors see the readings?

options.label: On a screen by the entrance

questions.explanation: The first paragraph locates the screen by the entrance.

questions.prompt: On which day did volunteers check the equipment?
questions.explanation: The second paragraph says the check happened each Friday.

questions.prompt: The project was intended to replace the national forecast.
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly says it did not replace the national forecast.
